name.zh: 扶椅背屈肘肱三头肌拉伸

purpose.en: Stretch the backs of your upper arms and your armpits.

text.zh: 手肘搭在椅背上，臀部后移胸口下沉
text.en: Rest your elbows on the chair back, push your hips back and let your chest sink

text.zh: 双肘弯曲，手放在颈后附近，不碰头
text.en: Bend your elbows with your hands near the back of your neck, not touching your head.

text.zh: 膝盖微屈，背部拉长，头在双臂之间
text.en: Keep your knees soft, back long, head between your arms.

commonErrors.en: Sagging the lower back to push deeper.
Pushing on the head or neck.

cautions.zh: 肩部疼痛时减小幅度，用稳固的椅子
cautions.en: Reduce the range if your shoulders hurt, and use a sturdy chair.
